enumeration_note: Single taught short setup (50 MA rejection â†’ bar close under 25 EMA â†’ short the channel break) narrated through one trade; exit is given loosely ("exit on this bottom level") so exit levels stay gestural but the entry is runnable, so it is kept as one strategy object.

coaching_notes: "i gave enough time i don't want to wait too long because sometimes if you don't see that move in time then usually price goes back up"

element_inventory: PRECONDITION: price rejected from the 50 MA with a weak close
ENTRY: enter short on a bar that closes under the 25 EMA (confirmation bar)
SCALE-IN: add a second contract on a pullback after initial entry
STOP: move stop to break-even once price moves away from the entry point
INVALIDATION: kill the trade if price closes back above the 25 EMA
TARGET: exit at the bottom channel level; projected down-move roughly equal in size to the first down-leg
OCCURRENCE-SELECTION: exit if the expected down-move does not happen in time (time-based invalidation)
strategies.entry_summary: After price is rejected from the 50 MA with a weak close, wait for a bar to close under the 25 EMA; enter short on that confirmation bar (anticipating a channel break and continuation move down). Add a second contract on a pullback.
strategies.exit_summary: Move stop to break-even once price moves away from entry; kill the trade if a bar closes back above the 25 EMA. Target the bottom of the channel / a projected move roughly equal to the prior down-leg.
strategies.name: ema25_channel_break_short
